meta.name: budget-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "allocate my influencer budget", "optimize spend across tiers", or "compare budget scenarios"; produces a tier/platform/content allocation table, ROI and CPM/CPE projections, scenario comparisons, and mid-campaign reallocation moves. Not for building the full campaign plan — use campaign-planner.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分配网红预算并优化投放支出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理网红营销预算并对比不同投放方案。
copy.tagline_en: Allocate influencer budget and optimize campaign spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage influencer marketing budgets and need to compare spending scenarios.

howto.what: 当用户要求分配网红预算时，Claude 会生成一个预算分配表，包含层级/平台/内容类型，并给出 ROI、CPM/CPE 预测、多场景对比以及中期重新分配建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出“分配我的网红预算”、“优化各层级支出”或“比较预算方案”等请求时触发。也适用于规划新活动预算、估算成本、模拟保守/激进场景或基于表现重新分配预算。

say.text: 帮我分配一个3万美元的Instagram和TikTok网红活动预算。
say.note: Claude 会生成预算分配表和预测结果。

say.text: 对比5万和10万美元两种预算方案，针对Z世代产品发布。
say.note: Claude 会并排展示两种场景的分配和预测。

say.text: 根据现有支出数据，重新分配中期网红预算。
say.note: Claude 会分析实际 vs 计划并建议调整。

howto.what_en: When asked to allocate influencer budget, Claude produces a tier/platform/content allocation table with ROI, CPM/CPE projections, scenario comparisons, and mid-campaign reallocation recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "allocate my influencer budget", "optimize spend across tiers", or "compare budget scenarios". Also used for planning new campaign budgets, estimating costs, modeling scenarios, or reallocating mid-campaign.

say_en.text: Allocate a $30,000 budget for an Instagram and TikTok influencer campaign.
say_en.note: Claude generates allocation table and projections.

say_en.text: Compare a $50K and $100K budget scenario for a Gen Z product launch.
Reallocate mid-campaign budget based on current spend data.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes actual vs plan and suggests moves.
